verdict.rationale: First-party docs show a Cost Management REST API for exploring cost and usage data through multidimensional analysis, with custom filters and expressions over Azure resources. That covers the queryable-API core of the story. However, the pack has no evidence of scheduled cost exports, and resource-level granularity is only implied by 'for your Azure resources'. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring cost exports, explicit resource-level cost granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration of the cost API.
